records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for flagging the notification badge — Tariq believes it's sorted, and your ticket is still open on our side, so do let us know if you're still seeing the count stick.

Since our welcome call, I wanted to help with the next step: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week work to get your first project set up together? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Chidi
